evidence: M-O s.v. incense burner, censer, thurible
terms.comment: Also spelled thūribulum, as in the Vulgate. The same vessel in both churches; the Orthodox censer has little bells on its chains.
From thȳmiāma, incense. Egeria calls the censers carried into the Anastasis before the Gospel by a related Greek name (24.10).

phrases.latin: Et alius angelus vēnit, et stetit ante altāre habēns thūribulum aureum
phrases.english: And another angel came and stood before the altar, holding a golden censer

sources: Lewis & Short: turibulum · Lewis & Short: thymiamaterium
